items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Ella Logan was definitely in New York singing before I got here. And she appeared on some of the swing programs.

ctx.x: (inaudible) Claude Thornhill may have gotten the idea -- may have triggered something, or that was part of some --

Actually the time that I did Lock Loehman, I think one of the first efforts -- I'm pretty sure they've been swinging classics forever -- you know, bands (inaudible) as a novelty -- but Tommy Dorsey had just recorded "Song of India," and the interest seemed to have in that direction of swing, you know, picking up some old things -- classics or whatever. And given them the swing treatment. I understand -- In fact, after I did Lock Loewend and it became such a sensation on the street, Ella Logan appeared one night…
